title: Clinic: The Half-Checked Triangle
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Three side lengths (up to 10^12); print YES if they can
form a triangle, NO otherwise (degenerate a+b==c is NO).

**The submission below checks only a+b>c — Wrong Answer.** Give two
counterexamples (one false-YES, one false-NO) and fix it.

tests.name: normal
half-check trap
tests.hint: a+b=8>2 passes the single check (buggy YES), but 3+2=5 is NOT > 5 → NO. Discriminates.

tests.name: degenerate
max values
tests.hint: Huge equal sides: equilateral, and long long must hold 2·10^12.
